item.title: Deploying Containerized NestJS Applications on GCP Using Cloud Run
item.content:encoded: While there are numerous ways to deploy an app to Cloud Run, see how to containerize and deploy a NestJS API. We will use a few products on GCP, such as Buildpacks and Artifact Registry, to build and deploy our image, and then finally deploy it to Cloud Run.

item.title: AI Cost Visibility Before the Invoice: How to Trace, Measure and Optimize Token Spend
item.content:encoded: Learn how to measure and optimize AI token spend before billing surprises hit. Discover why production AI costs diverge from estimates and how trace-level observability helps teams control LLM spending.

item.title: Creating Reliable AI Resources with Telerik Agent Tools API
item.content:encoded: The RAG resources you create to use with your LLMs are strategic resources, just like your organization’s databases. Telerik Agent Tools let you create the custom tools for managing those resources.

item.title: Protect Your Entities with Domain Validation
item.content:encoded: Learn about error-prone domain validations in ASP.NET Core and how to correctly model them.

item.title: Installing and Basics of Telerik UI for .NET MAUI AI Coding Assistant
item.content:encoded: Check out the Telerik UI for .NET MAUI AI Coding Assistant, the MCP server native to Telerik controls and MAUI.

item.title: How to Build a Multi-Tenant SaaS API with NestJS and Postgres Row-Level Security
item.content:encoded: We’ll build a multi-tenant task management API where customer data is isolated automatically at the database level. We’ll use Postgres Row-Level Security to enforce tenant isolation, with NestJS as our application framework and TypeORM to interact with the database.

item.title: Creating a Custom AI Agent with Telerik Tools 6: Embedding Conversational and Invisible Agents
item.content:encoded: Different kinds of AI-enabled applications need different UIs. Progress has the components you need for all of them.

item.title: Streaming Server Events with SSE and Blazor
item.content:encoded: Understand the SSE standard, the .NET 10 changes to simplify SSE endpoints and how to add real-time events to your Blazor clients.

item.title: How to Verify Network Connectivity in .NET MAUI
item.content:encoded: Learn the key steps to checking network connectivity in the various platforms available to your .NET MAUI app.

item.title: How to Build Semantic Search for Documentation with NestJS, Qdrant and Xenova
item.content:encoded: In this post, we’ll build a semantic documentation search API that lets users ask natural-language questions instead of matching exact keywords.

item.title: Design Principles Unpacked, No. 4: Balance
item.content:encoded: Balance creates stability, but it's not the finish line. Harmony composes differences toward a shared purpose—in layouts, teams and life.

item.title: Creating More Realistic Tests with In-Memory Databases in ASP.NET Core
item.content:encoded: Testing ASP.NET Core APIs with in-memory SQLite and JustMock enables validation of real-world scenarios like pagination, keys and rules without a real database.

item.title: Creating a Custom AI Agent with Telerik Tools 5: Creating an Interactive UI in JavaScript
item.content:encoded: If you’re going to give your users access to an AI-enabled backend in JavaScript, you need to give them an AI-appropriate frontend.

item.title: Routing Management and Creating NotFound Pages in Blazor
item.content:encoded: Route handling got better in .NET 10. Let’s see how to create context for managing information on an error page and show users specific error pages.

item.title: Integrating Haptic Feedback in .NET MAUI
item.content:encoded: Learn how to give your users interactive feedback with long or short haptic vibration in your .NET MAUI application.
